The BGM remains steady with a rhythmic electronic beat. (3) The speaker's tone shifts to one of excitement and high arousal as she exclaims 'Super cute!' during the reveal of the fox-eared plush. The plastic crinkling continues in the foreground. (4) A low 'thud' is heard as a box is placed on the table, followed by a slight pause in speech as the BGM swells briefly.
